text: Local preview: `npm start` (port 3000, hot reload). `npm run build` is the real check, because broken links only fail the production build.
onBrokenLinks is 'throw'. Moving or renaming a page needs an entry in redirects.json, or the build fails and old links 404.
Prose is linted with Vale (`npm run lint:prose`). The Handbook style bans 'simply', 'just' and 'easy' and enforces the terms in .vale/styles/Handbook/Terms.yml.
New pages must be listed in sidebars.ts; autogenerated sidebars are off, so an unlisted page builds but can't be reached from the nav.
Guide code samples use the <ApiTabs> component (curl, JS, Python), and every sample must run as written against the sandbox API.
API v2 uses OAuth access tokens in the Authorization header. v1 API keys in the X-Api-Key header stop working on 2027-03-31.
v2 pagination is cursor-based (next_cursor); v2 endpoints ignore v1's page and per_page parameters.
Diagrams are SVGs in static/img/<section>/, exported from sources in design/diagrams/. Add alt text and commit the source in the same PR.
Headings are sentence case. The H1 comes from the front-matter title; don't add a # heading in the body.
The docs site is built with MkDocs; preview with `mkdocs serve`.
API v2 is internal-only; don't mention it in the public docs.
The changelog page is generated from GitHub releases by scripts/fetch-changelog.ts at build time; don't edit docs/changelog.mdx by hand.
Blog posts live in blog/ and need an author entry in blog/authors.yml; marketing reviews every post.
SDK reference pages under docs/sdk/ are generated from TypeDoc on each SDK release; hand edits there are overwritten.
Every PR gets a deploy preview. Tech writers review the prose; the owning API team reviews technical accuracy.
Site search is a local plugin indexed at build time; it skips pages with `unlisted: true` in front matter.
Put <VersionBadge version="v1"/> or "v2" at the top of reference pages. Don't write 'new' or 'old' in prose; it ages badly.
Brand colors and the logo come from tokens in src/css/custom.css; dark-mode overrides sit in the same file under [data-theme='dark'].
Translated pages (ja, es) live in i18n/<locale>/ and are synced weekly from the translation platform; never edit them by hand.
The status widget in the navbar polls a public status JSON every 60 s; it is disabled in local dev.
Admonitions: use only :::note, :::tip, :::warning and :::danger; custom admonition types break the PDF export.
The v1 API deprecation date is 2026-12-31.
